highlights: Transactional Ledger & Multi-Currency Supplier Payments, Shared Safe Helpers, Bounded PDF Renderer & Lazy Admin Tools
changes: Transactional Ledger & Multi-Currency Supplier Payments, Shared Safe Helpers, Bounded PDF Renderer & Lazy Admin Tools

Transactional Internet & Regular Supplier Payments: Wrapped RecordPayment, DeletePayment, and PaySupplier in atomic DB transactions with FOR UPDATE safe/counter locking, proper foreign-currency conversion via ledger.ResolveRateToBase, and base-USD supplier balance adjustments

Unified Safe & Ledger Mutation Helpers: Added ResolveRateToBase, ConvertToBase, WithdrawSafe, and DepositSafe in pkg/ledger and migrated supplier payments, collector handovers, direct customer payments, and receipts to atomic SQL balance updates

Bounded Headless Browser PDF Concurrency: Added a server-wide concurrency semaphore in RenderReceiptViewPDF (max 2 concurrent headless Chromium/Edge renders) to prevent CPU/RAM spikes during bulk receipt views or payments

Notification Outbox & Cron Hardening: Typed ScheduledAt and MaxRetries in EnqueueNotificationItem (defaulting max_retries to 3 for expiry reminders) and scoped settings BulkUpdate key lookups per company
Frontend Performance & UX Polish: Lazy-loaded all 9 AdminTools sub-tabs with React.lazy + Suspense, synced Collection Date display on mobile receipt cards, and cleaned up case-colliding locale keys
